_README: Which equipment types a class can actually hold, and per-item fixes to the
job sentence the site ships.
This file is maintained by hand and is NOT generated. It exists because the
site's item payload carries only a job sentence per item ('All except
Bouncer, Judge, ...'), and that sentence is the only restriction data there
is -- no payload lists what a class may hold. Where the sentence is broad
the planner ends up offering a class gear it cannot equip: a Satsujin gets
Heavy Shields and Colossal Shields because no shield's sentence excludes
Satsujin by name.
Two sections, both optional:
'classes' -- keyed by class name exactly as data/classes.json spells it.
'weapons'     the item types allowed in the weapon hand (one- and
two-handed both; a Colossal Shield is a two-handed weapon
as far as the slot is concerned).
'off_hand'    the item types allowed in the off hand.
'ammunition'  the item types allowed in the ammunition slot.
A key that is absent leaves that slot unconstrained for the class, so a
partly-filled entry never hides gear nobody has checked. A class absent
from this file keeps the job-sentence behaviour on every slot. Filling it
in one class at a time is the intended way to use this.
'items' -- keyed by exact item name, correcting the job sentence itself.
'usable_by' is written in the site's own grammar ('Prowler', or
'All except Judge, Peacekeeper'), so it runs through the same reader as
the real sentences. Use this where the sentence is wrong about one item
rather than wrong about a whole class.
'status' is either 'verified' (checked in game) or 'unverified' (a best
reading, not yet confirmed), as in overrides.json. Both are applied; the
difference is what the build reports.
A class name, item name or type that matches nothing is reported as stale
rather than ignored -- otherwise a data update would silently drop a rule.

Satsujin.reason: Project owner, from play: a Satsujin holds a dagger, and a one-handed shield in the off hand. The shipped sentences let it through to 4 Colossal Shields (which sit in the two-handed weapon slot), the 4 general Armguards, to Fleinn (a bow), and to Abomination's Scythe, Sigrsverd and Maladeilan, which ship with no job sentence at all. Heavy Shields were barred here once too, but the site files the ordinary one-handed shields under that type -- Guard, Mirror Shield, Valkyrie Shield -- and the owner confirmed in game (2026-09-25) that a Satsujin wears them. Offhand Daggers are Shadowseer only.

Loki's Scarf.reason: Project owner, from play: locked to Unchained Assassin. It ships with no job sentence, so every class qualified; its description raises Assassin and Rogue skills to level 13, which is the Unchained cap.

Unbound Gem of Full Power.reason: Project owner, from play: probably Phantom Thief. Every other class gem names its class; this one ships with no job sentence, so every class qualified.

Loki Gem of the Traitor's Path.reason: Project owner, from play: probably Unchained Assassin. Ships with no job sentence, unlike the other class gems.

Polymath Gem of All Schools.reason: Project owner, from play: probably Unchained Rogue. Ships with no job sentence, unlike the other class gems.
